title: Customers sorted by signup
statementMd:
List customer names with their signup date, earliest signup first.

Expected columns: `name`, `signup_date`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, signup_date FROM customers ORDER BY signup_date;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
